payload.summary: Coordinate routed crossing evaluation with P02
payload.text: P01 currently evaluates strict straight center-to-center crossings at one hierarchy level; overlap pairs and node hits cannot worsen versus baseline. Can P02 provide a metric for final polyline routes, including cross-region edges, self-loops and parallel/reverse transitions? Please agree on the metric before any shared API change. P03 should verify viewport and save/reload behavior.
